intro: Vitis-idaea vitis-idaea, commonly known as Cranberry Moss or Rock Cranberry, is a low-growing, evergreen species of flowering plant in the heath family (Ericaceae). The plant is known for its small white flowers and red berries, which have been traditionally used in herbal medicine to support urinary health and prevent infections. The health benefits of Vitis-idaea include its ability to prevent bacteria from adhering to the bladder and urinary tract walls, reducing the risk of urinary tract infections (UTIs). The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
